exit_condition_status: Exit (1) for this group is NOT met on main 1544d1d1. Of 12 issues, all 12 still hold in full or in part; none is judged closed. Must before beta.3 (7): #188 M, #131 S, #186 remainder S, #177 S, #374 S, #354 M, #376 M. Should (4): #168 L, #178 S, #179 M, #365 M. Defer with a CHANGELOG known-limitations line (1): #138 L. The CHANGELOG [Unreleased] section has no known-limitations section yet, so exit (4) is also open. Two findings go beyond what the issues say. First, the #177 probe shows a model-authored read path pushing an ST-terminated OSC 52 (clipboard write) and ESC[2J through render_tool_call_line to the terminal. Second, #376 is a general gap in restoring the session model, not only a compaction problem: restore_model_from_session has no caller, and a headless --continue with no default model cannot run a prompt at all.
summary: Group A (security and records), read-only on main 1544d1d1. All 12 issues still hold, 2 of them only partly (#186: the copilot half shipped in 080a1ec; #365: the launch path was fixed by _route_universe, but /model and the registry still merge catalogue rows). Probes ran under /tmp/beta3-assess/A with fake keys and isolated agent and settings dirs. They confirmed: #188 (qualified MCP names are not in _MUTATING); #177 (OSC 52 clipboard write and ESC[2J pass through the real tool-call line render); #374 (the SDK client picks up ANTHROPIC_API_KEY for a custom base_url); and #376. For #376, rpc --continue leaves the model at api=unknown even though the session holds 6 messages and a model_change, and a prompt then fails while the user message is still persisted. The cause is that restore_model_from_session (core/model_resolver.py:912) has no caller, while pi restores the model at sdk.ts:200. The rest were read, not run. Estimate: 7 must lanes, about 2 S x3 + S x1 + M x3. At this batch's pace (S about 2 rounds, M 3-5, plus Codex), that is roughly 20-25 implement/verify rounds. With current file overlaps it fits in two parallel batches. Pairs that must not share a batch: #354 and #376 (cli/entry.py); #177 and #168 (tui/render.py); #186 and #379 (oauth/openai_codex.py); #365 and #376 (model routing). The 4 should items add about 12-18 rounds, mostly #168 (L, needs a wire-format decision first). #138 should be deferred with a known-limitations line, which pi also lacks. Each must item needs a live check: an MCP server for #188; the TUI for #177 and #179; real models for #354, #374 and #376.
